authority: Parent-assigned calibration of user wording: 覆盖原程序全部声明的阶段、dtype 和分支；缺少验证的 numerical assumptions 可明确登记后延期。
summary: Current scope-gap prose overextends the standard to generic compiler/runtime/hardware and harness correctness. Preserve finite source-specific obligations and exact numerical deferrals; do not relax evidence, hide source bugs or count rejected dtypes as successful kernels.
checker_required_boundary_explanation: The gate checks the reviewed structural_gaps list and exact scope/numerical evidence. Generic native/compiler obligations arise in ledger/review prose, not a separate checker predicate. Source-to-model semantic review remains mandatory.

finite_acceptance_definition.requirement: Freeze exact original source and production entrypoints; inventory every production kernel/helper/wrapper, literal dtype branch, implicit promotion, output cast, mask, loop and declared launch configuration. Retain test helpers in inventory but mark them test_harness only after the checker production-call/JIT review. Top-level test invocations do not require proving Python import or RNG internals.

State a finite supported API/target dtype domain grounded in source declarations and actual canonical signature admission. For each case, classify success or first rejection. A missing Python guard does not quantify over every possible Python object. A rejected route is covered by faithful rejection, never by inventing a successful kernel; a known accepted route cannot be omitted.

For successful cases, execute every source stage and operation and prove the complete source-visible returned memory/metadata/frame, including loops, tails, masks, casts and source store gates. Source-to-model correspondence is substantively reviewed and pinned; a standalone numerical formula or source-independent protocol is insufficient. Different faithful typed interpreters are permitted.

Host composition is a finite sequence of specified Python/Torch/launch primitives: allocation metadata/freshness, exact size/stride calculations, assertions, selected configs, calls and return wiring. Primitive implementation correctness is trusted. Primitive numerical operations such as abs/max/reciprocal may be abstract or deferred numerically, but producer/consumer wiring must be proved. Do not replace launch success or final values with an unconstrained assumed result.

Make source-relevant memory/layout and integer-address admission explicit. Bind actual view bases/strides/offsets; prove or represent finite-width behavior, lane/program ownership, source races and actual masks. Under fresh disjoint output and disjoint access footprints, a finite independence argument suffices; proving CUDA allocators, MMUs, schedulers, caches and compilers is outside this standard. New safety restrictions must be named and justified, not silently presented as coverage of a larger source domain.

Every unverified numerical law or callback, including concrete software arithmetic-to-native correspondence, must be registered by exact statement/case/dtype/operation/configuration and future validation. Such conformance may be deferred. Missing fp64 operations, incorrect promotion, undefined-value-domain restrictions, omitted source stages or known false conclusions cannot be numerically deferred. An OutputDefined premise needs a documented defined-behavior domain or a faithful complementary outcome, not a promise that all inputs satisfy it.

Bind current public whole-stage execution evidence through scope_schema2, exact original_scope IDs/cases and complete dtype-domain metadata, then obtain an independent substantive root review. Keep required build/axiom/source/comparator checks separate. No blanket compiler/hardware correctness gate may be added merely because native_functional_correctness remains not_established.

Keep as-written behavior and the intended mathematical operator distinct. A source bug is not repaired by broadening metadata or numerical assumptions. Full source characterization may be recorded truthfully, but a refuted intended functional claim cannot count as verified. ReLU pid-zero-only tail behavior remains explicit even after fp64 completion.

gap_classification.original_finding: RELU-C-S1: Native storage, access and address correspondence. The allocation/read/write maps and ordered byte failures remain selected mathematical semantics. Native allocation, layout/strides, little-endian storage, alignment, pointer provenance, access rights, finite-width index/pointer behavior and native fault/poison/trap order are not related to this interpreter. Existing finite-address certificates are preserved but are not a native pointer simulation.
gap_classification.retained_finite_obligation: Bind source element offsets/masks to tensor views and a stated admitted integer-address domain. Account for actual source-visible out-of-bounds/overflow rather than assuming safe arbitrary shapes.
gap_classification.trusted_boundary_or_non_obligation: Little-endian hardware implementation, allocator provenance implementation, MMU/access-fault/trap/poison ordering and compiler pointer simulation are ordinary target semantics boundaries; no universal proof is demanded by this standard.

gap_classification.original_finding: RELU-C-S2: Python/frontend/native compiler and host/module stages. The checked program now composes with all seven exact statements of the frozen manually materialized TypedValue.source, using its real step and exec functions. This closes the earlier custom-load-to-source-block gap and computes every pid result. It is not independent Python extraction, TTIR/LLVM/backend correctness, native empty_like freshness, wrapper/layout validation, launch admission/error or import-time test-harness/module closure.
gap_classification.retained_finite_obligation: Retain a reviewed exact source-to-model correspondence and public composition of wrapper dtype/device/numel/block/grid/return with all successful typed routes. Existing HostWrapper.relu_logical_correct covers12 routes and should receive credit.
gap_classification.trusted_boundary_or_non_obligation: Independent verified Python extractor, LLVM/backend correctness, implementation proof of empty_like and import-time harness/module closure are not additional production-stage requirements.

gap_classification.original_finding: RELU-C-S3: Native scheduling and error correspondence. Every complete permutation of whole programs is executed against preceding state, with a complete source trace per pid. Programs remain atomic relative to one another. Native instruction interleavings, synchronization, races, concurrency faults and callback evaluation side effects remain outside the model. Structural failures and per-byte access failures are explicit custom errors, not proofs of native observable errors.
gap_classification.retained_finite_obligation: Check finite source read/write footprints and independence under a fresh disjoint output; all active high-pid loads and pre-gate computations remain required. Preserve genuine source races if they exist.
gap_classification.trusted_boundary_or_non_obligation: Universal GPU instruction interleavings, synchronizer/runtime/fault implementation and hypothetical numerical callback side effects are not separate blockers. Numerical callbacks are pure functions in the accepted semantics.

gap_classification.original_finding: RELU-C-S4: Remaining original dtype and admission/error families. This package refines only the same nine integer/bool profiles. Floating fp16/bf16/fp32 byte/source composition, fp64 and fp8 execution/admission/error routes, and noncanonical/complex/quantized/packed dtype/device/layout/module branches remain structural work. The original17-profile audit and12-profile logical materialization are unchanged.
gap_classification.retained_finite_obligation: Add actual fp64 source execution, integrate13 successful profiles, classify4 observed fp8 rejection routes at their real first stages, and bind the finite wrapper domain. Preserve source-specific layout/address assumptions.
gap_classification.trusted_boundary_or_non_obligation: Do not demand successful rejected fp8 kernels, duplicate byte-level proofs for the already executed fp16/bf16/fp32 logical paths, or every arbitrary Python object/complex/quantized/packed type merely because no dtype assert is written. Any claimed accepted extra route requires positive source/API admission evidence.

gap_classification.original_finding: VA-F64-S2-remaining: Native instruction trace and scheduling. Logical memory, masks, stores, frames and complete sequential program permutations are proved. runLanes computes/writes each lane in order with reads from a fixed program-entry snapshot; it does not execute or refine load-all/compute-all/store-all phases, native instruction interleavings or memory races.
gap_classification.retained_finite_obligation: Use fresh output and disjoint lane windows to justify the same result for source load/compute/store ordering. Retain source-level races for APIs that permit writable aliases.
gap_classification.trusted_boundary_or_non_obligation: Do not prove the whole GPU scheduler or all native instruction traces. Here input-input aliases are harmless reads; empty_like supplies a distinct live output under the trusted API contract.

gap_classification.original_finding: VA-F64-S3: Native storage, finite addresses and memory admission. String/Nat logical regions and indexed words do not establish physical byte layout/endianness, provenance, allocation extent, native pointer admission, signed i32 pid/offset/mask arithmetic or overflow behavior.
gap_classification.retained_finite_obligation: Bind tensor views/storage offset/extent and finite pid/offset arithmetic to the successful-domain theorem. A missing logical input cell is not silently a valid source input.
gap_classification.trusted_boundary_or_non_obligation: Do not require per-task implementation proofs of endianness, CUDA provenance or physical byte memory when typed load/store semantics already define widths.

gap_classification.original_finding: VA-F64-S4: Wrapper, inactive-lane, errors and host composition. Output separation is an explicit selected-domain premise, not wrapper freshness or physical nonaliasing. Logical missing-input/undefined-conversion errors return no final memory and prove no native poison, traps, partial-write visibility or rollback. Native masked-load behavior, allocation/device dispatch and Python/Torch module/harness composition remain open.
gap_classification.retained_finite_obligation: Compose empty_like dtype/shape/freshness, CUDA assertion, output.numel, block1024/grid and return with typed execution. Treat undefined numeric conversions as explicit operation outcomes or faithfully modeled policies; do not claim native rollback from custom errors.
gap_classification.trusted_boundary_or_non_obligation: Generic allocation/runtime failure machinery, exact poison/trap/partial-write visibility and module/harness composition are not required absent a source-specific observable claim.
